description.value: Canooligans Lake Lounge & Eatery is a full-service restaurant and live-music venue situated on Canoe Beach Drive in the small lakeside community of Canoe, BC, near Salmon Arm. The venue draws its identity from a local folk legend—'The Canooligan'—a mythic adventurer associated with the early history of Canoe, giving the place a distinctly community-rooted character. Cyclists touring the Shuswap region would find a sit-down dining option with a full menu including Sunday brunch, regular live music events, and a lively atmosphere.
